Assumptions and method

Route 8 times come from its schedule: Home Depot pickup 6:52 AM, school arrival 8:00 AM, and the afternoon run, which leaves about 3:20 and reaches Home Depot at 4:24. Van times use road data with traffic factors set so the same method reproduces Route 8's scheduled times, plus three minutes at the stop. Door-to-school times add the drive to Home Depot and five minutes at the stop. Homes are shown rounded to about a quarter mile. Late days stay on the existing late activity bus (NA-Ath-3), which stops at Home Depot at 6:36 PM. The Route 8 saving assumes its bus starts and ends at school and that General Booth and S. Birdneck becomes its first morning stop.
